established_work.established_result: Recurrent deterministic and stochastic RSSM latent physical/visual world models, reward and imagined policy learning are known and much more complete than the compact RSSM control
established_work.paper: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models (DreamerV3)

established_work.established_result: Input-selective discretized state-space recurrent models are known; this micro diagonal control is not a complete Mamba reproduction
established_work.paper: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces

literature_gap.unresolved_TAConly_question: Does learned persistent fast/slow/associative native TAC memory, using unchanged physical features and priors, predict physical state better than compact RSSM, selective recurrent SSM, GRU and strongest persistence or servo on genuinely new actual robot task?
literature_gap.what_is_not_being_rediscovered: No novelty claim for RSSM, KL, recurrent GRU, input-selective stable SSM dynamics, Bayesian mixture-of-experts, servo physical forecasting or conformal uncertainty. Exact data/parameter/compute and real independent task outcomes are used as an empirical challenge.
